# AgencyDomains

> The formal architecture of the Agentive World. An open specification for building agentic and
> agentive AI in production: the AgencyDomain as the minimal unit of deployment; four layers
> (Interaction, Cognition, Autonomy, Access); canonical primitives — Botlet, Capability,
> Trust Infrastructure, Facet. Edited by GegoLabs. Pre-1.0.

## The trilogy

Three volumes answer, in order, the three questions of the transition — each reads complete on its own:

- **I · The Real-Time Enterprise — The Agentive World**: where are we going? — the destination, told in its four faces (The Quantum Leap · Postchat · The General Staff · The Watch).
- **II · AURA — The Agentive Path**: which way? — the route. Its four specs (IRIS · MOTOR · Data Canon · Wingmap) are standalone instruments.
- **III · AgencyDomains — Agentive Architecture**: how do we get there? — the vehicle.
- **Vergis — Agentive Technology** *(not a book: code)*: what do I start with today? — the keys.

## The book — The Real-Time Enterprise · The Agentive World (Book I)

Formerly published as "Postchat"; Postchat now names its communication face. Old URLs under /postchat/ redirect.

- [The Agentive World Trilogy — unified agents manifest (English, Markdown)](https://agencydomains.org/AgentiveWorld-Trilogy-agents-en.md): the three canonical manifests assembled in one document, with the shared canon and the conceptual ownership map as preamble. One fetch, the whole trilogy.
- [Trilogy — same manifest as plain text (.txt, alias)](https://agencydomains.org/AgentiveWorld-Trilogy-agents-en.txt)
- [The Real-Time Enterprise — canonical manifest for agents (English, Markdown)](https://agencydomains.org/RealTimeEnterprise-v0.4-agents-en.md): the destination distilled for an agent to reason within the framework — people as infrastructure, the four faces with their questions and measures, the agentive mode, the intelligent organization. v0.4.
- [The Real-Time Enterprise — same manifest as plain text (.txt, alias)](https://agencydomains.org/RealTimeEnterprise-v0.4-agents-en.txt)
- [The Real-Time Enterprise — web edition (English)](https://agencydomains.org/real-time-enterprise/): the full book, navigable — the film (Elena's Tuesday, hour by hour) plus the commentary.
- [The Real-Time Enterprise — PDF (English)](https://agencydomains.org/real-time-enterprise/RealTimeEnterprise-v0.4-en.pdf)
- [The Real-Time Enterprise — Spanish edition (web)](https://agencydomains.org/es/empresa-tiempo-real/) · [PDF](https://agencydomains.org/es/empresa-tiempo-real/EmpresaTiempoReal-v0.4-es.pdf) · [agents manifest](https://agencydomains.org/es/EmpresaTiempoReal-v0.4-agents-es.md)
